audit.why: 52.5% over 1158 games and the chart is Annie on all seven rows — TF has no lane answer to a banked Pyromania, only map value from Destiny (170s at rank 1).
His spikes are global, not local: Destiny at 6 and the roam cycle. Annie's spikes stay level 6 and first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every reference told you to watch the gold card glow; the actual tell is the auto-attack reset, and Pick a Card carried no cooldown or range.
audit.why: Pick a Card is a 6-second, 200-range ability whose lock is spent through an auto-attack reset — by the time you see him swing the stun is already committed, so the wind-up is the cue and the 200-range walk is the punishable part. Wild Cards is 6/5.75/5.5/5.25/5s and costs up to 100 mana, which is what actually runs him dry.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, early, wants.you[1] and breakdown.carry.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[2].text claimed you one-shot him 'from 3.5k range'.
audit.why: Annie's Disintegrate is 625 range and Summon: Tibbers is 600 — there is no 3500-range threat anywhere in the kit. The sentence would have a reader standing far outside any window she actually has.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to the real 625 range and his 6-second card cycle.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Wild Card' singular in spikes[0], early and wants.you[1].

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Molten Shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Pick a Card is 6 seconds flat and spends through an auto-attack reset: the wind-up is the tell, not the glow, and he must reach 200 range to use it. - Budget E Molten Shield for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.

edits.before: The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Commit on its cooldown, never into it.
edits.after: The gold card spends as an auto reset — the wind-up is the tell, not the glow. It is 6s flat; step in on the miss and stun him.

edits.before: Carry through the one button — Flash-Tibbers on two is a won fight; your whole game is engineering the radius.
edits.after: Carry by holding the glow for his gold card: he has to walk to 200 range to land it, and that walk is your kill.

edits.before: If Twisted Fate takes first blood, tighten up: Pick a Card (Gold) is now always up in your head. A second kill means the duel is over and the game isn’t — farm with Q refunds and stay relevant through stocked-stun threat.
edits.after: If Twisted Fate takes first blood, farm behind the wave and watch his auto wind-up rather than the card glow — gold still needs 200 range. Keep the Q refunds going and hold the stun for the step-in he has to make.

edits.before: Ahead, shrink the lane: hold the glow, zone Twisted Fate off CS by existing, and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt — fed Annie ends games at 20.
edits.after: Ahead, hold the glow and stand outside his 200-range card window; take CS freely and Flash-Tibbers the recovery attempt before Destiny lets him leave.

edits.before: Once you have Q-W-E all up you can stun off a Q proc or a passive-charged auto and dump a full combo before Twisted Fate can even land a Wild Card poke, punishing his low base damage early cards hard.
edits.after: Once you have Q-W-E all up you can stun off a Q proc or a passive-charged auto and dump a full combo before Twisted Fate can even land a Wild Cards volley, punishing his thin early card damage hard.

edits.before: Post-Sorcerer's Shoes/Shard your stun-Tibbers burst starts one-shotting him from 3.5k range before his card cycle can reset, so he plays passive and just farms.
edits.after: Post-Sorcerer's Shoes/Shard your stun-Tibbers burst kills him inside your 625 Disintegrate range before his 6-second card cycle resets, so he plays passive and just farms.

edits.before: Twisted Fate's Wild Card poke chips you down before level 3, but he has no real answer to your stun once your combo comes online — a single hit-confirmed Q into full rotation kills him outright in most of levels 1-2 if he misplays position.
edits.after: Twisted Fate's Wild Cards poke chips you down before level 3, but he has no answer to your stun once the combo is online — his gold card spends as an auto reset, so react to the wind-up and a hit-confirmed Q into full rotation kills him outright.

edits.before: Track his mana for Wild Card poke so you know when he's forced to auto instead
edits.after: Track his mana — Wild Cards costs up to 100 and dries him out quickly
